notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (8): Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the total.
The list as published totals 59 cards, not 60 (Characters is headed 17 but lists 18; Interrupts is headed 17 but lists 16); the counts are kept as published.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: no Coruscant-set card is listed (Imperial Arrest Order is the plain Endor card) and the post does not mention Coruscant.
The strategy's 'Cardlist edit' changes Set For Stun to Control & Set For Stun, makes Rise, My Friend x2 and Twi'lek Advisor x1; the list here is the one posted.
Posted 'Mara Jade, Luke's Nightmare' (no such card) dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand, the only era Dark Mara Jade character with a comma subtitle.

Posted 'Darth's Saber' dested Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere), not Darth Vader's Lightsaber (Death Star II): the strategy counts '+1 w/saber' to Vader's Force drain, which only the Premiere saber gives.
Posted 'IAO' (no slash) dested the plain Imperial Arrest Order (Endor), not the Coruscant combo; 'Mob. Points' Mobilization Points; 'D2 Throne Room' Death Star II: Throne Room.

Posted 'Boba Fett w/blaster' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; '4-LOM w/blaster' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Dengar w/blaster' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Emperor' Emperor Palpatine; 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Emporer's Power' Emperor's Power.

Posted 'Executer DB' dested Executor: Docking Bay; 'Executer Holotheatre' Executor: Holotheatre; 'Coruscant DB' Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'D2 DB' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'Spaceport DB' Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark); 'Bossk in Hounds Tooth' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Sense/Uncertain is the Future' and 'Sniper/Dark Strike' the Reflections II combo Interrupts.
